name: When should a financial advisor consider investing in Answer Engine Optimization?
description: Financial advisors should invest in AEO when target clients use voice search and AI-driven answers, or if their valuable content isn't visible in direct answers

mainEntity.name: When should a financial advisor consider investing in Answer Engine Optimization?

acceptedAnswer.text: A financial advisor should consider investing in Answer Engine Optimization when they recognize the growing trend of voice search and AI-driven answers. If your target clients are increasingly using devices like smart speakers or asking direct questions to search engines, AEO becomes crucial. It's especially beneficial if your firm has valuable, informative content that isn't currently performing well in featured snippets or 'People Also Ask' sections. Investing now positions your firm ahead of competitors who may still rely solely on traditional SEO strategies.
acceptedAnswer.description: Financial advisors should invest in AEO when target clients use voice search and AI-driven answers, or if their valuable content isn't visible in direct answers.
